content: Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. This information was last updated in May 2024. Important Usage Information: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible details about the product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific situation. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete details about this product and your individual health needs. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Keep a record of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share this list with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and take the next dose at the regular time. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store the medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Avoid flushing medications down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard the product when it is expired or no longer needed. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the applicable plan provider for the most current details.
